# Curriculum map — 32 lectures

> **PM-401 Project Management** · Semester 7 ·
> BS Computer Science, BS Data Science
> Instructor: Dr. Muhammad Nadeem Majeed · 16 weeks ·
> 32 lectures x 2 h =
> 64 contact hours

## Units at a glance

### U1 — Foundations & Strategy (W1, W2)

Why projects fail; strategic alignment; project, program, portfolio; PMBOK 7 principles and performance domains; roles and the PM profession.

### U2 — Life Cycles & Initiating (W3, W4)

Predictive, agile, hybrid life cycles; charter and stakeholder analysis; agile role system; tailoring for software and data projects.

### U3 — Planning the Work (W5, W6, W7)

Scope and WBS; estimation; CPM/PERT scheduling; cost, budget, quality, and data-quality planning.

### U4 — Risk, Uncertainty & Control (W8, W9, W10)

Risk management aligned to ISO 31000; PERT and simulation; procurement; EVM and adaptive monitoring; change control.

### U5 — Adaptive Delivery & Teams (W11, W12, W13)

Scrum, Kanban, SAFe overview, hybrid; team performance; stakeholder communication and negotiation; data-specific team topologies.

### U6 — Integration, Ethics & Closing (W14, W15)

Master planning; ethics and professional responsibility (PMI Code); sustainability; closure, lessons learned, benefits realization.

### U7 — Synthesis & Capstone (W16)

AI-assisted project management; capstone defense and course synthesis.
